description: Algorhythm Project announced by Realic Production focusing on music and virtual entertainment.
Launch of Celestial Operation unit ORION (Dacapo, Baabel, Schneider), reaching 100k subscribers in record time.
Graduation of multiple ARP talents including Quentin (2025-04-02), Ricotta (2025-04-03), and Ayna (2025-04-04).
Retirement of Asteroth and Latta from Algorhythm Project.
Debut of Pixela 1st Generation (Cazzie, HongFei, Melita, Laguna, Zelina).
Retirement of 1st generation members Hinabe HongFei (2023-11-28), Laguna Juju (2023-11-29), and Melita X (2023-11-30).
Debut of Pixela-World-End unit (Beta AMI, Xonebu X'thulhu, Kumoku Tsururu, Mild-R, Debirun, T-Reina Ashyra).
Graduation of Princess Zelina, concluding Pixela 1st Generation active history.
Pioneer Thai VTuber YuChan debuted under Kadokawa Amarin (Phoenix Next).
HØRI 07 founded Virtual Zeven Co., Ltd. agency operations with 'viewers as owners' concept.
Pioneer Thai YouTuber/VTuber TheQuillmon re-debuted with Live2D model under Virtual Zeven (The Good Old Days unit).
Brave Group APAC announced the launch of AStars and debut of inaugural unit Chrono Prince.
Debut of all-female unit Amakara (Lenezmee Dollynx, Amaris Sayo, Zia Sylph, Ice Shirakoi).
Graduation of Amakara members Amaris Sayo (2025-02-14) and Ice Shirakoi (2025-04-30).
Aisha debuted under Guardian Angel A.I., later anchoring Polygon 0th Gen.
Polygon Project launched by 4 Thai companies (KP Comics, Shin-A Service, Guardian Angel A.I., Polygon Official).
Graduation of pioneer VTuber Aisha after 6 years of activity.
Closure and cessation of RPG agency talent operations.
